title: Wendell and the Orbit
author: Emrys Winterbourne
blurb: Kestrel Eriksen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
